The intended Industrial and Corporate Change article is Climate change and growth (2023; Stern and Stiglitz); the candidate Economic Journal article is A Time for Action on Climate Change and a Time for Change in Economics (2022; Stern). Shared author and topic do not establish the same publication.

Crossref shows distinct Journal of Finance and Management Science articles with different research aims, page ranges, and DOIs; each reference list cites the other DOI. OpenAlex reports 2021 for the Management Science record while Crossref published date is 2023; the year discrepancy does not merge their identities.

The intended Natural Hazards review concerns weather, climate, and transport; the candidate Tourism Geographies article concerns tourism geographies. They share a lead author but differ in title, coauthors, journal, and publication year.

The intended Science of the Total Environment article studies microplastics in bivalves; the candidate Science Advances article studies Alaska pollock. Overlapping authors do not make these the same publication.
